Chapter 9 | Ch 9: Water-Soluble Vitamins| Quiz and
Test
1.Water-soluble vitamins include Vitamin C and B
vitamins such as Thiamin (B1) and Niacin (B3).
2.Vitamin C toxicity can lead to neurological symptoms and
is considered safe even at very high doses.
3.Folate is vital for DNA synthesis and its deficiency can
lead to megaloblastic anemia.




Chapter 10 | Ch 10: Fat-Soluble Vitamins| Quiz and
Test
1.Vitamin A is primarily found in colorful fruits and
vegetables.
2.Vitamin D is synthesized from sunlight and helps in
calcium absorption.
3.Vitamin E is only considered important for eye health and
has no other functions.
Chapter 11 | Ch 11: Major Minerals| Quiz and Test
1.Minerals constitute about 4% of total body weight
and play important roles in nutrition and
metabolism.
2.Trace minerals are needed in quantities greater than 100 mg
per day.
3.Regular exercise promotes bone density and strength.
